responsibility: Declares `ASTTypeBuilder`, a `DefaultASTVisitor` subclass dedicated to reconstructing Rust AST type nodes. The header defines the static `build(Type&)` entry point, the `visit` overload set for the major concrete type syntaxes in `rust-type.h`, and the internal translated-result slot used to return a newly built `Type`, establishing the interface for type-only AST duplication/transformation support alongside the more general `AST::Builder` helpers.
same_name_distinction: Declares the `ASTTypeBuilder` class, its `build(Type&)` API, visitor override surface, and result-storage member for type rebuilding. Unlike the paired `.cc` file, this header provides the interface and class shape for same-stem type-builder support rather than the concrete cloning logic for each type form.
